He makes a peace sign with two fingers and holds them horizontally across his eyes, mimicking a pair of glasses or a mask. His expression is joyful and energetic, maintaining the humorous tone established throughout the sequence. (6) In a wider medium shot, both men stand side-by-side in the gym setting. The blonde man on the left points his finger upward with a serious but comedic pose, while the dark-haired man on the right crosses his arms and looks at the camera. They occupy the center of the frame, surrounded by gym machinery and overhead industrial lights.
